items.t: Air suspension (Airmatic) sagging or compressor failure
items.job: Replace one leaking air strut (compressor if worn out)
items.note: Struts run about $400–$1,200 per corner; a compressor is about $600–$1,500 installed. Rebuilt and aftermarket parts cost less.

items.t: Balance shaft or timing idler gear wears out
items.job: Replace timing idler gear, timing chain and related parts
items.note: Very labor-heavy; the engine may need to come out on some cars.

items.t: Electronic brake pump (SBC) wears out or fails
items.job: Replace SBC hydraulic brake unit
items.note: Reconditioned units cost less than new.

items.t: Glass sunroof panel can come loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace sliding sunroof panel under recall

items.t: Head bolts corrode and leak coolant (AMG 6.2L V8)
items.job: Replace cylinder head bolts and head gaskets (both heads)

items.t: Ticking from worn camshafts (AMG 6.2L V8)
items.job: Replace camshafts and followers (one or both banks)

items.t: Intake manifold flaps stick or break
items.job: Repair or replace variable intake manifold

items.t: Harsh shifts or transmission limp mode
items.job: Transmission fluid service or conductor plate replacement
items.note: Fluid service is the low end; conductor plate replacement plus coding is the high end.

items.t: Supercharger coupling wears out (AMG 5.5L)
items.job: Replace supercharger coupling/isolator

items.t: Secondary air pump failure
items.job: Replace secondary air pump

items.t: Oil leaks from valve covers and rear main seal
items.job: Replace valve cover gaskets (rear main seal costs more)

items.t: Fuse/relay module (SAM) fails from water
items.job: Replace and program SAM module

items.t: Front control arm bushings and ball joints wear
items.job: Replace front control arm (one side) and align

items.t: Wrong software coding can affect fuel shutoff (recall)
items.job: Recode software calibration under recall

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioner, camshaft adjusters and chain if stretched

items.t: Turbocharger oil feed lines leak
items.job: Replace turbo oil feed lines and seals

items.t: Sudden coolant loss from cracked pipe or thermostat housing
items.job: Replace coolant pipe or thermostat housing and refill

items.t: Hood rubber seal can fall onto exhaust (recall)
items.job: Secure or replace engine bay rubber seal under recall

items.t: Side sections of LED tail lights may not light (recall)
items.job: Lighting control software update under recall

items.t: Hood latch bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Check and retighten hood latch striker bolts under recall

items.t: Airbag control software may be incorrect (recall)
items.job: Control unit software update under recall

items.t: Emergency call system may report wrong time or location (recall)
items.job: Communication module software update under recall

items.t: Electronic parking brake won't release or apply
items.job: Replace electronic parking brake actuator

items.t: Turbo wastegate rattle (AMG 5.5L)
items.job: Repair wastegate linkage or replace turbocharger

items.t: 48-volt mild-hybrid system faults
items.job: Replace 48-volt battery (or software update)
items.note: Software-only fixes are usually free under warranty.

items.t: Coolant pump wire can chafe on fan (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair coolant pump wire under recall

items.t: Engine can stall from powertrain controller reset (recall)
items.job: Powertrain controller software update under recall

items.t: Steering rack locknut can break (recall)
items.job: Replace steering rack under recall

items.t: Transmission wiring can corrode and short (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission wiring harness under recall

items.t: 48-volt ground connection can overheat (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair 48-volt ground connection under recall

items.t: Fuel pump can shut down and cut power (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump under recall

items.t: Trunk 12-volt battery may not be secured (recall)
items.job: Secure 12-volt battery under recall

items.t: Rearview camera image doesn't show (recall)
items.job: Camera and multimedia software update under recall

items.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves
items.job: Intake valve walnut-blast cleaning

items.t: Buckled seat belts may read as unbuckled (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front seat belt buckles under recall
